**Global Child Care Services:** 
Their site says they run weekly EarlyON drop-ins at locations around Ottawa for infants, toddlers and preschoolers.
 
The Blackburn Hamlet drop-in is listed for Tuesday and Thursday mornings at 9 a.m.
 
Attendance is free.
 I could not find the street address or a fall date range for this location. The listing's table was jumbled, so check before you go.

**Western Ottawa Community Resource Centre:** 
Their page says specialized playgroups run Tuesdays in partnership with CHEO.
 
It also says all in-person EarlyON programs there are drop-in with no registration required.
 I did not find a start time on the page. It is a specialized group, so I could not tell whether anyone can join. A phone call would settle both.

I searched for libraries and other operators too. I left out Ottawa Public Library toddler programs because the schedules I found were for other dates. I also left out Mothercraft's Sensory Playtime, which 
next runs Monday, November 16, 2026
, so it is not on today.
